apiContract.note: tests dictate this model surface; Unit loses `resumed`
apiContract.SessionOptions: { enabled: string[]; haltOn?: string; project?: ProjectFacts }
apiContract.ProjectFacts: { prd: 'template'|'populated'; techTemplates: number; initiatives: number; epics: number; stories: number }
apiContract.semantics: without `project` a session is story-scoped (rows 6-11 only); with it rows 1-5 apply: row1 prd template; row2 prd populated AND techTemplates>=3; row3 initiatives=0 AND epics=0; row4 initiatives>0 AND epics=0; row5 epics>0 AND stories=0. Rows are evaluated in cascade order 1..11 (first match wins across rows 1-5 and 6-11); a matching row whose step is disabled is skipped and evaluation continues at the next row. row 7 effect leaves the unit unchanged; the Step 6 hand-off (row 7 ran for the unit in this session -> row 8 step implement) is session state, never a Unit field. When the session ran no step: (a) when an enabled row of ANY mode holds for the board (the unmoded cascade proposes it; row 7 is always enabled), the exit is 'wrong-context' with suggest = the mode of the first such row (it outranks 'all-disabled'; skipped still lists the mode's own disabled rows); (b) otherwise, when the mode lists a Fallback-only step that the profile enables and the backlog has NO EPICS, that step is run once and a HALT it raises is surfaced as-is (exit 'halt', halted = the step); (c) otherwise 'all-disabled' when a row of the mode was skipped, else 'nothing-to-do'.
